'''Hinton Thomas''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[March 2001 Buford tournament]] on 31 March 2001 with [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|QMC]], according to Adam Drake's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2024">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-05-ta-black-goes-to-buford-3-31-01d2024/ ta-black-goes-to-buford-3-31-01], DeckTech (Adam "ADrake" Drake, 5 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-05-ta-black-goes-to-buford-3-31-01d2024/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
